summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords as an int (ndim, 2) array in the unpadded frame; docstrings updated; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter wrapping iter_patch with channel-prepended patch_size; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates and to iterate items with per-patch transform via apply_transform; NotImplementedError on missing len; math replaced by numpy.ceil; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_len). Nothing was run, per instructions. The pinned values in test_loading_array are unverified until pytest runs. The two-worker block re-seeds with a fresh pipeline. No commits were made.
